title: refactor(ci): simplify lint/test/release workflows, dedupe steps and improve cache parallelism
author: Evelyn Park
description: Consolidate duplicated steps across lint, test and release workflows into reusable workflow templates and a shared actions library. Motivation: reduce maintenance overhead, improve cache hit rates across job matrices, and make future pipeline changes low-risk. This PR: 1) introduces .github/workflows/common-templates.yaml with reusable jobs for setup, checkout, install-deps, and test-run; 2) extracts cache and matrix helpers into .github/actions/cache-helpers; 3) consolidates node versions and normalizes environment variables across repo workflows; 4) simplifies release/workflow dispatch flow by moving release packaging to a single well-tested job; 5) improves cache key strategy to reduce cache fragmentation and enable parallel restore/save safely. Checklist: - [x] Add reusable workflow templates and document usage in docs/ci.md - [x] Move cache key logic into an action with concurrency guard - [x] Update all repo workflows to use templates (lint/test/release) - [x] Run full CI across monorepo and resolve flakes - [x] Validate release automation on staging. Notes: initially observed intermittent cache restore failures under high concurrency; introduced a lightweight lock via the new cache-helpers action and normalized save timing to post-job only when relevant. Also bumped actions/github-script and setup-node to latest minor for Node 20 compatibility. This description is intentionally continuous without section breaks to match PR export conventions.
